db_connection_exhaustion.title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
steps: Check current connection count: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity;
Identify long-running queries: SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle' ORDER BY duration DESC;
Scale connection pool size in service configuration
Terminate idle connections if pool is saturated
Check for connection leaks in application code
Monitor connection count after remediation
db_connection_exhaustion.prevention: Set up connection pool monitoring with alerts at 80% capacity

memory_leak.title: Memory Leak
steps: Identify the leaking process via container memory metrics
Capture heap dump if possible
Restart the affected pod to restore service
Review recent deployments for memory-related changes
Profile the service with memory analysis tools
memory_leak.prevention: Set memory limits and implement automated restart policies

cpu_spike.title: CPU Spike / Saturation
steps: Check CPU usage per container: kubectl top pods -n <namespace>
Identify CPU-intensive operations in application logs
Scale horizontally if load-driven
Check for infinite loops or runaway computations
Review recent code changes for performance regressions
cpu_spike.prevention: Configure HPA with appropriate CPU thresholds

network_latency_injection.title: Network Latency / Partition
steps: Verify network connectivity between affected services
Check network policies and firewall rules
Inspect DNS resolution times
Review recent network configuration changes
Check for bandwidth saturation on nodes
network_latency_injection.prevention: Implement circuit breakers and timeout policies

pod_crash_loop.title: Pod Crash Loop
steps: Check pod logs: kubectl logs <pod> --previous
Describe pod for events: kubectl describe pod <pod>
Check resource limits (OOMKilled?)
Verify liveness/readiness probe configuration
Check for missing environment variables or config maps
Rollback to last known good deployment if caused by bad deploy
pod_crash_loop.prevention: Implement proper health checks and resource limits

disk_io_saturation.title: Disk I/O Saturation
steps: Identify I/O-heavy processes on the node
Check disk usage and available space
Review log volume — excessive logging?
Check for large temporary file accumulation
Consider moving to faster storage class
disk_io_saturation.prevention: Monitor disk I/O metrics and set alerts at 80% utilization

cold_start_storm.title: Cold Start Storm
steps: Check HPA scaling events
Verify pod readiness probe timing
Implement connection pre-warming
Consider increasing minReplicas during peak hours
Add pod disruption budgets

config_error.title: Configuration Error
steps: Identify the changed configuration via deployment history
Rollback the configuration change
Verify service recovery after rollback
Review the config change for errors
Add validation to the config deployment pipeline
config_error.prevention: Implement config validation in CI/CD pipeline

dependency_timeout_misconfig.title: Dependency Timeout Misconfiguration
steps: Review timeout settings in service configuration
Check p99 latency of the dependency under normal load
Adjust timeout to 3x p99 latency
Implement circuit breaker pattern
Add retry with exponential backoff
dependency_timeout_misconfig.prevention: Standardize timeout configurations and review during deploys

cascading_retry_storm.title: Cascading Retry Storm
steps: Immediately reduce retry rates or disable retries
Identify the original failing service
Fix the root cause before re-enabling retries
Implement exponential backoff with jitter
Add circuit breakers to prevent amplification
cascading_retry_storm.prevention: Implement exponential backoff, jitter, and circuit breakers

certificate_expiry.title: TLS Certificate Expiry
steps: Identify expired certificate and affected service
Renew the certificate immediately
Deploy the new certificate
Verify TLS connections are restored
Set up automated certificate renewal (cert-manager)
certificate_expiry.prevention: Use cert-manager with auto-renewal and expiry alerts at 30 days

rate_limiter_misfire.title: Rate Limiter Misfire
steps: Check rate limiter configuration and current thresholds
Compare actual traffic against limits
Temporarily increase limits if blocking legitimate traffic
Review rate limiter logic for bugs
Add per-client rate limiting if using global limits
rate_limiter_misfire.prevention: Test rate limiter changes in staging before production

queue_backlog.title: Message Queue Backlog
steps: Check consumer health and processing rate
Scale consumers horizontally
Check for poison messages blocking the queue
Monitor queue depth and consumer lag
Consider dead-letter queue for unprocessable messages
queue_backlog.prevention: Set up queue depth monitoring with auto-scaling consumers

bad_deploy_regression.title: Bad Deployment Regression
steps: Identify the problematic deployment
Rollback to the previous version immediately
Verify service recovery after rollback
Analyze the deployment diff for the regression
Add regression test before re-deploying
bad_deploy_regression.prevention: Implement canary deployments and automated rollback

resource_limit_misconfig.title: Resource Limit Misconfiguration
steps: Check current resource requests and limits
Compare against actual resource usage patterns
Adjust limits based on profiling data
Ensure requests match typical usage, limits allow for burst
Apply and verify the changes
resource_limit_misconfig.prevention: Profile services and set data-driven resource limits

dns_resolution_failure.title: DNS Resolution Failure
steps: Check CoreDNS pods status: kubectl get pods -n kube-system
Verify DNS resolution from affected pod: nslookup <service>
Check CoreDNS logs for errors
Restart CoreDNS if necessary
Check for DNS policy misconfigurations
dns_resolution_failure.prevention: Monitor CoreDNS health and set up DNS failover

connection_leak.title: Connection Leak
steps: Identify the leaking service via connection count metrics
Restart the affected service to release connections
Review code for unclosed connections or missing finally blocks
Implement connection pool max-lifetime settings
Add connection leak detection in tests
connection_leak.prevention: Use connection pool libraries with leak detection enabled

autoscaler_misconfig.title: Autoscaler Misconfiguration
steps: Check HPA configuration: kubectl get hpa
Verify the target metric is correctly scraped
Check metrics server is running
Adjust scaling thresholds and cooldown periods
Test scaling behavior under simulated load
autoscaler_misconfig.prevention: Validate HPA configs in CI and load test scaling behavior
